latest.notes:
Traffic: Edit and Delete on every commercial row, and :90 / :120 spot lengths.

• Each commercial row now carries its own Edit and Delete buttons. Delete asks for confirmation exactly as before — double-click still opens the editor, and the buttons under the list still work on the selection.
• Nominal length now offers :90 and :120 alongside :10, :15, :30 and :60. Nominal is a label for selling and reporting; breaks are still packed by each spot's actual measured length.

Includes v0.5.84: Replace Audio no longer takes a file that another element is using.
